panels.title: Accounts with no proxy
panels.description: Event twins are left out: they always use their main's proxy. The runner gives a proxy only to accounts that should run, so stopped accounts can have none.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) filter (where desired_state = 'running') as "wanted running", count(*) as "all" from game_accounts where proxy_id is null and not external_event

panels.title: Accounts on each proxy, against its limit

targets.rawSql: select p.label as proxy, count(a.id) as accounts, p.max_accounts as "max accounts" from proxies p left join game_accounts a on a.proxy_id = p.id group by p.id, p.label, p.max_accounts order by p.label

panels.title: Proxy pool
panels.description: Load is assigned accounts over max_accounts, as the runner counts places: every assigned account, running or not. An admin's pin can take it over 100%. Switched off because is empty when an admin turned the proxy off.

targets.rawSql: select p.label, p.host_hint as host, p.enabled, count(a.id) as accounts, count(a.id)::float / nullif(p.max_accounts, 0) as load, p.consecutive_failures as "failures in a row", p.last_ok_at as "last ok", p.last_error_at as "last error at", p.last_error as "last error", p.disabled_reason as "switched off because" from proxies p left join game_accounts a on a.proxy_id = p.id group by p.id order by p.enabled, load desc nulls last, p.label

panels.title: Runs that failed on their proxy, per hour, by reason
panels.description: Runs whose error is a PROXY_* code from the worker (PROXY_AUTH, PROXY_TIMEOUT, PROXY_ECONNREFUSED...); they end as 'error'. A failure while looking up an event server opens no run, so it shows only in the proxy's last error.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(ended_at, '1h', 0), error as metric, count(*) as runs from bot_runs where starts_with(error, 'PROXY_') and $__timeFilter(ended_at) group by 1, 2 order by 1
